app.name: Watch Order
app.tagline: Your sagas, in the order you like.

hub.followHint: Follow the franchises you care about: they show up first, with what's next and upcoming releases.
hub.plannerBody: Build a marathon around your free hours and send it to your calendar.
hub.mapBody: Explore how titles, characters and teams connect.

title.spoilerHidden: Hidden to avoid spoilers until you watch it.

about.tmdb: This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.

account.title: Account & settings
account.guestBody: Your progress lives only on this device. Sign in with Google to sync it across devices and have several profiles. What you marked as a guest can be moved to your account.
account.signOutPending: Some changes haven't been uploaded yet (offline?). If you sign out now, they'll be lost.
account.signInError: Couldn't sign in ({{code}}). Please try again.
account.profilesHint: Each profile keeps its own progress. Handy if you share the account.
account.name: Name
account.deleteConfirm: Delete “{{name}}” and all its progress? This can't be undone.

sync.offline: You're offline. Your changes are saved and will sync when you're back.
sync.migrate_one: You have {{count}} change from guest mode on this device.
sync.migrate_other: You have {{count}} changes from guest mode on this device.

customOrder.name: Custom
customOrder.description: Your own order, saved to your profile.
customOrder.hint: Drag by the handle or use the arrows. With a keyboard: space to pick up, arrows to move, space to drop.
customOrder.srInstructions: To pick up a title, press space. Move it with the up and down arrows. Press space to drop it or Escape to cancel.

search.title: Search
search.placeholder: Search a title, franchise or route
search.hint: Works in English or Spanish, with or without accents.

upTo.title: Watched up to here
upTo.body_one: {{count}} pending title up to “{{title}}”, inclusive, following “{{order}}”, will be marked as watched.
upTo.body_other: {{count}} pending titles up to “{{title}}”, inclusive, following “{{order}}”, will be marked as watched.

versions.title: Version
versions.hint: The one you watched or will watch. Stats use its runtime.

notes.title: Notes
notes.placeholder: Only you see them. Saved when you leave the field.

providers.title: Where to watch in {{region}}
providers.none: Not on any platform in your region right now.
providers.offline: Offline: we'll check when you're back.

settings.spoilerFreeHint: Hides the overview of what you haven't watched until you reveal it.
settings.regionHint: Used to show where to watch each title.
settings.letterboxdToastHint: When you mark a movie as watched, offer to log it on Letterboxd.

backup.title: Your data
backup.hint: Export or import the “{{profile}}” profile's progress as JSON.
backup.mergeHint: For each title the most recent change wins. Nothing in “{{profile}}” is deleted.
backup.replaceHint: “{{profile}}” ends up exactly like the file: anything not in it is deleted.

errors.notBackup: The file isn't a Watch Order backup.
errors.newerVersion: The backup comes from a newer app version. Update and try again.

stats.title: Stats
stats.note: Hours use the runtime of the chosen version and include rewatches. Progress counts the continuities visible by default.

planner.title: Planner
planner.intro: Pick a goal and how many hours you have each week: the app spreads what's left across a calendar and recalculates it when you mark something watched or fall behind.
planner.none: You don't have any plans yet.
planner.completed: Goal reached! You've watched it all.
planner.lateTitle: At this pace you won't finish before {{date}}
planner.lateDetail: At this pace you won't make the deadline. Add hours or days, or move the date.
planner.essentialFits: With just the essentials you finish on {{date}}, in time.
planner.essentialLate: Not even the essentials fit: you'd finish on {{date}}.
planner.franchiseHint: The whole franchise, in your active order and with your visible continuities.
planner.essentialOnlyHint: Leaves out recommended, optional and skippable titles.
planner.deadlineHint: Optional. For “Get ready for…” routes it defaults to the day before the release.
planner.name: Plan name
planner.allWatched: You've already watched everything in this goal.
planner.estimated_one: {{count}} session uses an approximate runtime: TMDB has no data yet.
planner.estimated_other: {{count}} sessions use an approximate runtime: TMDB has no data yet.
planner.icsHint: Download an .ics with every session to import into any calendar. It's a snapshot of today: it won't update itself.
planner.feedHint: A private link your calendar checks on its own: it updates when the plan is recalculated. Anyone with the link can see the plan.
planner.feedGuest: Sign in to subscribe from Google Calendar or Apple Calendar.
planner.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the link and copy it by hand.
planner.deleteConfirm: Delete “{{name}}”? Your progress stays the same.

budget.title: How much time do you have?
budget.tooLong: Next up is {{title}} and it runs {{time}}. Try more time.
budget.nothing: Nothing released is left in this order.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.intro: Each lane is a continuity, in story order. Branches start at the title where they split off.
timeline.hint: Drag to move around and tap a poster to open it. In spoiler-free mode, what you haven't watched is blurred.

graph.title: Connections map
graph.intro: Titles linked to their characters, teams and continuities. Pick all franchises to discover crossovers.
graph.continuitiesHint: Starts from the continuities you have visible in each franchise; changes here only affect the map.
graph.svgLabel: Connections graph. Use the search below to pick a node and see its connections.
